propositions: fsck.py is 855 LOC, exceeding the 800-line module-size soft cap and is currently grandfathered via allowlist and ceilings files.
The cohesive --repair/A3-remediation cluster plus its shared support helpers are extracted into a new sibling leaf module fsck_repair.py.
fsck_repair.py must be a strict leaf that imports nothing from fsck.py, keeping imports one-way to avoid bidirectional imports.
fsck.py re-exports (re-imports) the moved names so attribute access and direct imports of symbols like _resolve_tracker_git_dir keep resolving for downstream modules and tests.
The refactor removes fsck.py's rows from the allowlist, ceilings, and the docs/architecture.md offenders remedy row upon graduation.
This is a pure mechanical refactor with no signature or logic changes, validated by the existing fsck test suites and the module-size contract test.
